alt.en: The paper describes proofs of kernel equivalence under exact arithmetic, with reported benchmark results. Trust still rests on operator semantics and whether the checked kernel matches the deployed one.
alt.zh: 论文介绍了在精确算术假设下核验内核等价性的方法，并报告了基准结果。可信范围仍取决于算子语义，以及接受核验的内核是否与实际部署一致。
